He tucked the note inside his coat, climbed back up to his lamp room, and kept the light burning a little more willingly that night.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有睁开眼睛。街灯泡着惨黄的光，把空荡荡的马路切割成一块块沉默的金属。偶尔一辆环卫车慢吞吞驶过，橙色警示灯在玻璃幕墙上转出一圈圈涟漪。便利店的霓虹灯是这条街唯一清醒的灵魂，收银台后的年轻人低着头，不知是在刷手机还是在打盹。远处有人踩着共享单车，链条发出细碎的声响，很快消失在拐角。高楼的某扇窗亮着灯，不知是谁彻夜未眠，或喜或忧。整座城市像一个巨大的肺，在黑暗里缓缓呼吸，等待第一缕光将它唤醒。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by calling itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem, like a set of mirrors facing each other.\n• Every time it calls itself, the problem gets a little smaller, until it hits a simple case it can answer right away without calling itself again.\n• Think of it like opening a present to find a smaller present inside, and inside that one another, until finally you find one with no box inside — that last tiny box is the answer you build everything back up from."}
